decisions.reason: Although only mentioned on the website, after another year of sunk costs and public commitment the firm is likely to continue the comfort insole rather than withdraw it.
The supportive insole has received continued investment and, despite limited visibility, management will likely justify its launch by keeping it on the market.
With its own product page and multiple models, the ergonomic safety shoe series represents a visible public commitment to innovation, making withdrawal unlikely.
The firefighter and rescue boot line is a substantial, publicly announced investment in a safety-critical segment, so the firm will likely persist.
As the flagship moulded insole shown on the home page and central to the firm's announced direction, it has the highest sunk-cost and justification pressures, so it will almost certainly be kept.
